name: astral-orchestrator
description: Beginner-friendly, model-routed orchestration for planning, delegating, verifying, and reviewing project work in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Simple, risk-aware delivery for any project.
interface.longDescription: Astral Orchestrator turns an everyday request into a clear outcome, keeps the Sol model in charge, routes bounded work to pinned Luna or Terra models at their configured efforts, verifies the actual result, and uses a fresh Sol reviewer before handoff.
defaultPrompt: Use Astral Orchestrator to complete this request and verify the result.
Use Astral Orchestrator in Quick mode for this small change.
Use Astral Orchestrator in Careful mode for this risky change.
